name: Inheritor
body:
The blood of an ancient, magical empire flows in your veins, even if your family members have no knowledge of their mythic pedigree. All your life you’ve had dreams that seem more like memories of a forgotten age.

Benefit You gain a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (history) checks and a +2 trait bonus on Appraise checks related to objects of ancient origin or made to identify ioun stones.
